integration_removed.description:
The Oncue integration has been removed from __HA_KEEP__.

The Oncue service has been discontinued and [Rehlko]({rehlko}) is the integration to keep using it.

To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) integration entries from your __HA_KEEP__ setup. [View your existing Oncue integration entries]({entries}).
integration_removed.title: The Oncue integration has been removed
